choices.label: Put the reserve van first
choices.receipt: The van leaves promptly. The clinic gains time; your depot count remains incomplete.

laterDialogue.speaker: Meera
laterDialogue.text: The reserve van came early enough for the evening desk. Thank you.

laterDialogue.speaker: Kavya
laterDialogue.text: We still owe the depot a full stock check. Helping today did not answer every question.

choices.label: Hear the clerk’s full account
choices.receipt: The clerk entrusts you with the full account. The clinic waits for the later dispatch.

laterDialogue.speaker: Meera
laterDialogue.text: The clerk’s reserve van finally arrived. We had to keep the desk waiting.

laterDialogue.speaker: Aadi
laterDialogue.text: We stayed to hear his full account. I will not pretend the delay cost you nothing.

choices.label: Document the stock with the clerk
choices.receipt: The stock count is recorded before loading. The clerk’s personal account remains unheard.

laterDialogue.speaker: Kavya
laterDialogue.text: The reserve van arrived after the count. The inventory and photographs agree.

laterDialogue.speaker: Meera
laterDialogue.text: A record helps. Go back and hear the clerk’s story too, when you can.
